description: This file defines the interface ClientConfig which provides configuration settings for the Connectivity service's client in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for retrieving various timeout and retry parameters, and an inner enum for predefined configuration value paths and defaults.

classes.name: ClientConfig
classes.description: An interface supplying configuration options for the Eclipse Ditto Connectivity service client, including connection timeouts, backoff durations, and retry limits.

classes.name: ClientConfig.ClientConfigValue
classes.description: An enum defining known configuration path expressions and their default values for ClientConfig.

methods.name: getConnectingMinTimeout
methods.description: Returns the initial minimum timeout duration when establishing a connection.

methods.name: getConnectingMaxTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout duration when reconnecting to a remote system.

methods.name: getSubscriptionManagerTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout for SubscriptionManager waiting for search commands.

methods.name: getMinBackoff
methods.description: Returns the minimum backoff duration after a connection failure.

methods.name: getMaxBackoff
methods.description: Returns the maximum backoff duration after a failure.

methods.name: getConnectingMaxTries
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of retry attempts for connecting to a remote system.

methods.name: getTestingTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration for testing a new connection.
